resources.string: %1$s, plus %2$d older

Set up Berlin offline by hand
1. Map: open “%1$s” and install the Berlin map. The map manager shows each map's real size. Downloading needs a connection and starts only when you choose it there.
2. Timetable: tap “%2$s”, choose “%3$s” (“%4$s” only for a signed official pack), then pick the Berlin timetable file.
3. Check: this screen then shows the timetable's valid dates, whether it is untrusted and whether a map is installed. An installed map does not prove it covers Berlin, and nothing here checks that map and timetable belong together.
Storage: the space needed depends on the files you choose. While a timetable is imported, the archive, a temporary copy of it, the extracted timetable and the previous pack can exist at the same time. This app cannot know those sizes in advance, so check your free space before you start.
